# Homebrew tap for Orin

```bash
brew install orin-lang/orin/orin
orin doctor
```

Upgrade with `brew upgrade orin`, remove with `brew uninstall orin` (and `brew untap orin-lang/orin`).

Supported: macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux (x86-64 and arm64). Orin needs a C compiler on PATH; `orin doctor`
checks the toolchain. Other routes: [docs/install.md](https://github.com/orin-lang/orin-lang/blob/main/docs/install.md).
Getting started: [the tutorial](https://github.com/orin-lang/orin-lang/blob/main/docs/tutorial/README.md). Releases before
1.0 are pre-releases ([stability policy](https://github.com/orin-lang/orin-lang/blob/main/docs/stability.md)).

`Formula/orin.rb` is generated by `tools/homebrew_formula.sh` in
[orin-lang/orin-lang](https://github.com/orin-lang/orin-lang) from the published release and its `SHA256SUMS`; each
release opens a pull request here with the new version. Edit the generator there, not the formula here. The template
of this repository lives in `dist/homebrew/tap/` of the compiler repository (ADR-0047 section 6).
